`./compile.sh` reports **`compiled OK`**.

## What was produced

`tests/org/apache/commons/lang/time/DateUtilsAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 4 test class (lib ships JUnit 4.x: `org.junit.Test` / `org.junit.Assert` both present), package `org.apache.commons.lang.time`, no external helpers or base classes, Java 1.6-safe syntax.

### Coverage (all expectations traced to `api/`)

| Area | Tests |
|---|---|
| Constants | `MILLIS_PER_*` / deprecated `MILLIS_IN_*` values, `RANGE_*` + `SEMI_MONTH` values from `constant-values.html`, `UTC_TIME_ZONE` zero-offset, public ctor |
| `isSameDay` (Date & Calendar) | javadoc examples (28 Mar 13:45 vs 06:01 → true; vs 12 Mar → false), different-year → false, null → IAE |
| `isSameInstant` (Date & Calendar) | millisecond equality true/false, cross-timezone same instant → true, null → IAE |
| `isSameLocalTime` | equal fields → true, field change → false, contrast with `isSameInstant` across zones, null → IAE |
| `parseDate` | single pattern (asserts parsed Y/M/D + zeroed time), pattern tried in turn, no match → `ParseException`, partial input → `ParseException`, empty array → `ParseException`, null args → IAE |
| `addYears/Months/Weeks/Days` | +/- amounts asserted via calendar fields, original unmutated, `addDays(d,0)` → equal-but-distinct object, null → IAE |
| `addHours/Minutes/Seconds/Milliseconds` | exact millisecond-instant shift (+/-), original unmutated, null → IAE |
| `add(Date,field,amount)` | MILLISECOND / YEAR / MONTH application, original unmutated, null → IAE |
| `round` (Date/Calendar/Object) | javadoc worked examples (HOUR→14:00, MONTH→1 Apr), down-round cases, DATE midpoint at noon, Calendar returns distinct non-mutated object, Object accepts Date/Calendar, wrong type → `ClassCastException`, null → IAE, year > 280M → `ArithmeticException` |
| `truncate` (Date/Calendar/Object) | javadoc examples (HOUR→13:00, MONTH→1 Mar), DATE/YEAR, `SEMI_MONTH` top→1st / bottom→16th, distinct non-mutated Calendar, Object type handling, wrong type → `ClassCastException`, null → IAE |
| `iterator` (Date/Calendar/Object) | javadoc July-4-2002 `RANGE_MONTH_SUNDAY` range (35 days, Jun 30 … Aug 3, yields `Calendar`s), `RANGE_WEEK_SUNDAY`/`RANGE_WEEK_MONDAY` (7 days, correct endpoints), `remove()` → `UnsupportedOperationException`, null → IAE, invalid rangeStyle → IAE, wrong Object type → `ClassCastException` |

The only compiler note is a deprecation warning from intentionally asserting the deprecated `MILLIS_IN_*` constants.
